reason: v12 accepted A-D and three E attempts, but exhausted its 100000 local token reservation before E attempt four. Its latest E error was a clear-room box intersecting posts and furniture. This separate run retains 16 calls, 4 attempts and 900 s wall time, raises the local accounted-token ceiling to 150000, adds a versioned clear-space instruction and names intersecting parts in feedback. Geometry rules remain strict.
scope: One 0.1.0 fixed A-F single-storey building case. Still not proof of broad production reliability.
sample_policy: One run. Every started call counts; v1-v12 are retained. Any further paid fix requires a new registered batch.

success.machine: result.json succeeds, source geometry validates, WIR package round-trips, Unity GLB and Minecraft schematic are produced from the same revision, and exact offline replay reproduces package and target hashes.
success.human: Inspect one single-storey timber house, street-facing connected entry and reachable room. File exports do not prove target import or actual walking.
success.report: Record calls, repairs, failures, elapsed time and provider usage. One pass is not reliability proof.
